newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Solid 7-month net profit 379 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Solid 7-month net profit 379 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippines' Solid Group Inc said on Monday it posted a 379 million peso net income in the first seven months of the year, exceeding last year's full-year net profit by more than 150 percent.
The consumer electronics manufacturer and distributor said gross revenues reached 5.1 billion pesos in the same period, which is higher than the 4.8 billion pesos registered in 1995.

"The exemplary results of operations during the period is a positive indication that Solid's 1996 revenue and net income forecasts of 9.1 billion pesos and 834 million pesos respectively can be achieved," the company said in a statement.
It said 35 percent of its overall sales are derived during the Christmas season.
The company, which recently launched a second public offering, is set to list 3.9 billion pesos worth of new shares on Wednesday.
Solid Group recently acquired a presence on the stock market by taking over a defunct mining company United Paracale Mining Corp U.PS.
Owned by the Lim family, Solid is the sole Philippine franchisee of Japan's Sony and Aiwa products in the country.
